description.embed_passage: This table describes 'all risks' insurance for a firearm, detailing coverage conditions and maximum compensation. The insurance covers full or partial damage to the insured firearm, subject to general and specific exclusions. Compensation will be the repair value or the firearm's value at the time of the damage, but not exceeding 7,500 ₪. The August 2020 edition of the apartment insurance policy includes this extension. 'All Risks' firearm insurance covers accidents not excluded by policy terms, and damage where the repair or firearm value does not exceed 7,500 ₪.
